title: Alhambra Golf Course
specs: Player-friendly 5,478-yard course with slope rating 115 and course rating 65.6
Three-level lighted driving range with Toptracer technology, open until midnight
Collared shirts recommended; t-shirts permitted; no tank tops, bare feet, or swimwear allowed
Junior rate for ages 17 and under
Private golf outings and tournaments for groups of 16 to 140 players, bookable up to one year in advance
Fivesomes permitted Monday through Friday only; max group size five including spectators
includes: Golf cart fees included in online tee time pricing
Golf cart rental available, two riders per cart; single rider carts available for extra fee
Access to three-level lighted driving range with Toptracer technology
gap: Duration of rounds not explicitly stated
blurb: Alhambra Golf Course is a player-friendly 5,478-yard course suitable for beginners and experienced players. It features a three-level lighted driving range with Toptracer technology, a short-game area, putting green, and practice bunker. The course offers private and group golf lessons, junior rates, and hosts tournaments and events.
extraNote: Cancellations requested at least 24 hours before tee time · No refunds once round has started; rain checks not issued · Single rider cart fee $35 per person, reduced to $25 for twilight rounds, subject to availability · Fivesomes allowed Monday-Friday only; max group size including spectators is five
